scope: Read-only workstation verification of frozen empirical files plus local code review and regression tests. No additional training, teacher inference, or OS action was executed by this audit.

fixed_findings.evidence: Missing/false online_causality_verified remains blocked; explicit availability proof plus end+future_support<=decision required.

Different real held-out source IDs, same canonical participant/session, full shuffle permutation, time-shift raw asset and exact timestamp difference validated. This checks logged metadata, not an independent model rerun.

Chronological train->validation->test enforced; canonical source/subject identities preserved; original full JSONL bytes and membership hashes checked; shared raw SHA intervals checked independent of participant aliases.
--source-records mandatory. All source IDs, including representative, must be train in actual frozen source manifest. Hash/source changes rejected before teacher or resume.
15 teacher jobs map to 225 frozen train references with original citations preserved and separate target-event evidence; no held-out references or new gold.
Original manifest bytes unchanged. Only decision metadata normalized under explicit flag and provenance recorded; no promotion of preprocessing to causal.

review_observations.finding: tokenized_prompt contains class vocabulary and optional predecision environment only; original_gold and original_event_description are not included in learner input. Teacher sees event text only for metadata normalization, not EEG decoding.
Model predict writes categorical results with action_executed=false; no model-controlled OS call occurs in eeg_llm.py.
206 resume validates unchanged ETag/Last-Modified before appending; prior mixed-generation defect has dedicated tests. AI pseudo labels stay downstream of raw byte acquisition.

node_worker polls and waits its child, so zombie PID presence is not running proof. Artifacts completion only proves nonempty paths; label/train remain unconfigured in fleet. Future controllers must verify matching run/job/checkpoint/hash/status rather than treating file presence as model success.
External controller must reject /proc state Z/X, protect against PID reuse, and require matching completion receipts; this audit did not independently test the root controller.

empirical_runs.training_time_scope: run training, validation and final test; excludes initial backbone load and download
empirical_runs.interpretation: All 78 predictions are mouse_click; 83.33% accuracy reflects majority-class prediction. EEG-specific predictive gain and autonomous ability were not demonstrated.

resource.measurement_method: CUDA allocator peak and process ru_maxrss during completed training, validation and heldout candidate inference; accelerator-synchronized per-record timings
resource.memory_measurement_scope: peak CUDA reserved bytes; separate host RSS check against physical host RAM; CPU and GPU bytes are not pooled
resource.latency_scope: candidate scoring, includes accelerator sync; excludes EEG loading/preprocessing and harness execution
resource.scope: This measures feasibility on this actual Colab L4 runtime, not on M1 or SFC Mac nodes. End-to-end harness latency and autonomous capability remain unmeasured.

preprocessing.interpretation: Metadata availability contract; successful retrospective classification alone does not establish prospective causal preprocessing.

eeg_shuffled.evidence_scope: Consistency of logged source IDs and original recording times; not an independent rerun of model inputs.

eeg_time_shifted.reason: identical complete held-out record set not supplied
